purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for a NeuroSyn welfare-record disclosure fixture.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through anchors for ordinary reconciliation, the second count, compartmented record custody, the rejected-event receipt, the early audit, four disclosure routes, and state-gated aftermaths.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the booth establishing frame, ordinary count, technical routine, routine decision, branch-aware routine fold, rejected receipt, evidence custody decision, auditor arrival, final disclosure threshold, and four ending families. The first appearance of the matching timecodes occupies its own object-closeup frame.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt supplies its complete visible room slice, lighting, materials, bodies, interfaces, and prop positions for a general image model. Prompt assembly adds the global style cue, refs only for visible characters, and triggered state or branch modifiers.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: bleak workplace-noir science-fiction illustration with dry humane observation, ink-wash shadows, restrained rust red and monitor amber against cold blue-gray metal, tactile paper receipts and worn industrial surfaces, readable silhouettes, cinematic framing designed for click-through interactive fiction.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each image prompt from global_style_cue, the scene base_image_prompt, visual refs for named characters and groups listed in visible_characters, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Continuity notes stay in tooling. Every render begins from the declared camera-specific scene-set input when that blockout exists.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture revisits one booth from several angles and makes sightlines, the sample drawer, paper custody, and the corridor entrance consequential. This plan defines stable zones, routes, cameras, occluders, staging slots, and receipt states for a future blockout.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Before high-consistency website rendering, construct a plan-view or 3D blockout from the embedded scene_set and provide camera-specific inputs for all repeated booth views.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide view from the south corridor door into a compact rectangular corporate welfare reconciliation booth on Mars. The west wall holds a pale treatment console, a label printer, locked medication drawers, and stacked paper tickets. The east wall holds a dark interface calibration rack with cable loops, sensor bars, and a narrow thermal rejection printer. A waist-high steel counter runs across the middle toward a ribbed observation window on the north wall. A two-sided steel sample drawer sits beneath the window; uplifted black ravens perch in a dim aviary beyond the glass. A red shred slot stands beside the south door. Cold blue-gray panels, worn floor strips, amber monitor light, and one warm counter lamp make each record system visibly separate.

visible_characters.default_stance: several ravens on aluminum perches beyond the north observation window

visual_continuity_notes: Use the south-door camera looking north. Treatment equipment stays west, calibration equipment east, counter and sample drawer center, observation window north, shred slot southwest.
The booth is a records workroom adjoining an aviary, not the whole containment annex.

Beyond ribbed glass, Latch, a compact glossy black raven with oil-blue feather sheen and a small silver interface band on the right leg, taps an aluminum perch above a bandaged juvenile raven. The west treatment console casts soft amber light over the paper count; dim aviary lamps hold the ravens in cooler shadow.

review_notes: The visual plan supplies a complete textual scene-set map with one coordinate frame, fixed zones, paper routes, occluders, camera slots, staging slots, and receipt-state anchors.
The plan is concept-ready and stageable, but high-consistency generated replay remains blocked on a camera-specific plan-view or 3D blockout, which this pass is not permitted to add.
